boards.title: Your First Weekend at The Catholic University of America, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe first-weekend route through named campus spaces and an adjacent landmark, with each stop grounded in current public information.

cards.title: Start with the campus map
cards.subtitle: Orientation stop on the Main Campus
cards.notes: Open the interactive map before heading out, then use building names rather than internal paths when meeting someone or arranging a ride pickup.
cards.short_summary: Get oriented across the Main Campus before choosing your next stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University identifies its Main Campus boundaries and provides an interactive campus map and wayfinding guidance.
cards.access_notes: Use the official interactive map; some internal shared-use paths are not open to private vehicles.

cards.entity_name: John K. Mullen of Denver Memorial Library
cards.title: Choose a reading-room reset
cards.subtitle: Main library on the south part of campus
cards.notes: Walk through the library’s listed floors and choose a study setting that fits your mood, from the Main Reading Room to designated silent-study areas.
cards.short_summary: A named campus library with mapped reading rooms and study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Mullen is Catholic University's main library; its interactive map lists the Main Reading Room, study areas, and silent study.
cards.source_title: Mullen Library Interactive Map | Catholic University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Consult the library’s current hours and access guidance before visiting.

cards.title: See what is on view
cards.subtitle: First-floor gallery in Mullen Library
cards.notes: Check the library’s current feature before you go, then make the May Gallery a short, focused visit between a walk and a study break.
cards.short_summary: A library gallery with a current exhibition program.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University Libraries identifies the May Gallery as the location for its Ethiopian manuscript exhibit.
cards.access_notes: Verify the current exhibition and library access details on the library website.

cards.entity_name: Basilica of the National Shrine of the Immaculate Conception
cards.title: Take in the Basilica
cards.subtitle: 400 Michigan Avenue NE, beside campus
cards.notes: Plan a quiet visit around the posted daily schedule, leaving room to look at the sacred art and architecture without treating it as a rushed photo stop.
cards.short_summary: A neighboring national shrine open daily to the public.
cards.evidence_claim: The Basilica states that it is open to the public 365 days a year, daily from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m.
cards.source_title: The Basilica of the National Shrine of the Immaculate Conception
cards.access_notes: The official site posts daily public hours of 6 a.m.–6 p.m.; worship services may affect access to some areas.

cards.title: Make the Pryz your meetup point
cards.subtitle: 601 Thea Bowman Drive NE
cards.notes: Use the Pryz as a practical rendezvous point, then check the university calendar or information desk for a student-facing event, service, or place to sit.
cards.short_summary: The university describes the Pryz as its center of campus activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University's events office calls the Pryz the center of campus activity for meeting, eating, studying, hanging out, and events.
cards.source_title: Events and Conference Services | Catholic University
cards.access_notes: Check event listings and building access information before planning a visit.

cards.title: Pause for a meal at Garvey
cards.subtitle: Campus dining commons at 602 Thea Bowman Drive NE
cards.notes: If you want a meal break, review the current dining options and use the indoor or outdoor seating areas to regroup before the next stop.
cards.short_summary: The main undergraduate dining commons with indoor and outdoor seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University describes Garvey Hall as its main undergraduate dining commons, with a 400-seat dining room and three outdoor dining areas.
cards.source_title: Dining & Places to Eat | Catholic University
cards.access_notes: Dining is a purchase or meal-plan activity; consult current Dining Services menus and access details.

cards.title: Sit outside on the lawn
cards.subtitle: Central campus green near Garvey Hall
cards.notes: Bring a book or a friend and use the lawn as a daylight pause between indoor stops; keep plans flexible around weather and scheduled campus activity.
cards.short_summary: An open campus green used for informal outdoor time.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University's campus coverage identifies green areas and open park-like spaces for relaxing, studying, picnicking, and informal recreation.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions and campus programming can change; follow posted campus guidance.

cards.entity_name: Eugene I. Kane Student Health and Fitness Center
cards.title: Fit in a movement break
cards.subtitle: 604 Fort Slemmer Drive NE
cards.notes: Check current eligibility and recreation information, then choose a short workout or student-led fitness class that suits your energy rather than overpacking the day.
cards.short_summary: A campus fitness facility with equipment and student-taught classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University describes the 7,000-square-foot Kane Fitness Center as featuring workout equipment and fitness classes taught by students.
cards.source_title: A Day in the Life of Catholic University
cards.access_notes: Confirm current recreation access, programs, and any required student credentials before entering.

cards.title: Check the DuFour schedule
cards.subtitle: Named campus athletics facility
cards.notes: Look for a current Cardinal game or facility program, then attend only if the posted schedule and entry details fit your group’s timing and budget.
cards.short_summary: A named athletic center supporting Catholic University’s Division III programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University identifies the Raymond A. DuFour Athletic Center as the site where its swimming and diving teams practice.
cards.source_title: A Day in the Life of Catholic University
cards.access_notes: Check the official athletics schedule and venue-specific entry information before attending an event.

cards.title: End with a campus performance
cards.subtitle: 3801 Harewood Road NE
cards.notes: Browse the current drama calendar and choose a listed performance if one is running; confirm the exact venue, start time, ticket policy, and accessibility details first.
cards.short_summary: A campus theater complex with main-stage and flexible performance spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University's Hartke Theatre complex contains the Main Stage, Callan Theatre, and Lower Lab Theatre.
cards.access_notes: Performances and ticket requirements vary; use the official drama calendar for current details.
